input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position on every material term: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days from the later of delivery or acceptance, and Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term (19.2) — equal to or better than the preferred 90-day services / 12-month software benchmark; and 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties. The remedy in 19.4 is real: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination of the affected item plus refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, and it is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty — 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties, is mutual, and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy; Section 21 likewise preserves caps without cutting back the warranty (and 21.4 survives failure of an exclusive remedy). Minor points noted only, not deviations: the refund is measured by "Fees paid" rather than "paid or payable," and cure is owed "within a reasonable period" rather than a fixed cure window.
